headline: Mexican peso depreciates against the dollar and closes its worst week since July 2024
summary: The peso kept weakening and is on track for its worst week since July 2024. Markets are anticipating a narrowing of the interest rate differential between Mexico and the United States.
why: The peso is Mexico's currency, and its value affects inflation, import costs and foreign investor returns on Mexican assets. Interest rate differentials with the US are a key driver of its moves.
original_headline: Peso mexicano se deprecia frente al dólar y cierra su peor semana desde julio de 2024
